headline: The flagship-compatible pair (CZ_3, parity) generates C6 on the oriented two-qutrit Pauli/sl9 lift. Parity is central symplectic -I, so it disappears on projective W33 but acts nontrivially on the 80 oriented Pauli vectors. CZ*parity has vector cycle type 2^4 6^12 and exact adjoint C6 multiplicities 16,12,12,16,12,12, matching the Holotrade flagship joint-adjoint spectrum.
scope: Exact finite representation fingerprint; canonical lattice-to-Pauli basis identification remains open.
